title: Automated bots are ruining the experience in WoW

posts.cooked: Running through zones in Classic Fresh and every herb node has a train of 5-10 automated mage/hunter bots pathing perfectly between them. They ignore whispers, teleport through walls occasionally, and listing things on the AH within milliseconds. It completely ruins the immersion and experience of playing a multiplayer game. It feels like playing with empty shells.
